en: to go to the hospital.
Ah, a match factory.
I see...
Please leave now. Phosphorus is poisonous.
You mustn't come here again.
Oh, honestly...
You're a worry. This factory handles
dangerous materials. It's no place to come
and go in fine clothes like those.
No, you needn't worry about me.
More to the point, how are you?
Yes, I'm well, thank you.
But you really are an odd one.
Either you're fearless, or you don't realize...
It's me who's worried sick.
! Here again?
I'm no longer surprised. You really do seem
far hardier than most people.
Even in this choking factory you carry on
as if it's nothing. It's a mystery.
I want to get back to my family soon.
For now, their monthly letter is my only joy.
Living alone in a big city like this,
working from dawn to dusk... it feels hollow.
Poor or not, I'd rather live with my family.
Hello...
What is it?
Sorry, I'm not feeling well just now...
Um, sorry, but could you come back later?
I have a terrible headache.
What brings you here?
You're always so well. I envy you.
By the time I get home I'm worn out,
and I don't feel like doing anything.
So at home, all I do is sleep.
Welcome. It's a shabby place, I'm afraid.
I don't even have time to clean or do laundry.
I miss my wife and children's faces.
You're welcome to come by any time.
Why ever is that?
I see. That must be hard.
Let's meet again some time. Goodbye.
Good evening. What's the matter?
Are you all right? You should see a doctor.
I see, so it's a match factory.
Don't be so nonchalant about it!
My apologies. I'll take my leave, then.
I'm sorry to have troubled you.
You... It's dangerous in here,
you mustn't just wander in.
You mustn't come here again, all right?
I was passing by, so I came to say hello.
Are you well? How is your health?
There you go again, so carefree.
I'm glad to hear it.
I appreciate your concern, but
I'm sturdy, if nothing else. I'll be fine.
Come now. It's me who's worried sick.
far hardier than most folk.
Hello. Excuse me.
note: Also Bruce, msg 223353 (he answers 'Yes. What can I do for you?').

en: and I can't bring myself to do anything.
How his family back home will grieve...
Nick... I'm sorry!
I'm sick of this fighting!
I must settle this soon... very soon...
My name is Arthur, a humble hairdresser.
I hope you'll remember me.
I am Arthur, a humble hairdresser.
you're out for a stroll?
, sir,
your fine looks never fail to impress me.
I am a humble hairdresser
by the name of Arthur.
I'm Arthur. I work as a hairdresser.
, sir, please do visit
my shop again.
May I ask who you are?
I don't believe we've met.
My humble name is Arthur, and
